ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface with sparse, high-intensity white punctate pixels; estimated macro-level white-to-black ratio is approximately 0.05:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent textured, brown/white masses (barnacle clusters) are attached to and protruding from the superior distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A significant jagged 'step' or indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately two-thirds of the distance from the median notch.
